laws: While readiness blockers exist, package.json must remain 0.0.0, readiness rcSelectable must be false, and no readiness/finalization RC or v1.0.0 publication coordinate may be declared.
When blockers are empty, BERS_V1_RC may select one exact accepted main SHA; the metadata commits that record RC selection or publication authorization must not silently move product code.
RC_SELECTED keeps package.json and packageVersionExpected at 0.0.0, releaseSha/releaseTag/publicationEvidence null, and releaseGenerated false.

RELEASE_AUTHORIZED requires package.json and packageVersionExpected 1.0.0, releaseTag v1.0.0, releaseSha/publicationEvidence null, releaseGenerated false, and an exact release-metadata-only delta from the selected RC coordinate.
The v1.0.0 publisher creates the tag/release on the exact current RELEASE_AUTHORIZED main SHA and generates the release manifest with that runtime SHA; no commit is required to contain its own SHA.

RELEASED is a post-publication ledger state: package version remains 1.0.0, releaseTag is v1.0.0, releaseSha is the already-published tag SHA, releaseGenerated is true, and publicationEvidence records the successful workflow/release evidence.
A release-affecting product fix after RC moves the RC coordinate to a new accepted main SHA and requires rerunning affected evidence before publication authorization.
